description: This file contains pytest test cases for testing FastAPI application endpoints. It dynamically imports a FastAPI app module based on parameters and verifies the API's JSON responses for various endpoints, including item creation, retrieval, user listing, and OpenAPI schema validation.

methods.name: TestClient get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports a FastAPI app module based on the request parameter and returns a TestClient instance for testing.

methods.name: test_post_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that posts a new item to the '/items/' endpoint and verifies the JSON response and status code.

methods.name: test_get_items(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that retrieves items from the '/items/' endpoint and verifies the response JSON and status code.

methods.name: test_get_users(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that retrieves users from the '/users/' endpoint and verifies the response JSON and status code.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test case that retrieves the OpenAPI schema from '/openapi.json' and verifies its structure and content.
